reviewNotes: All 48 lines / 249 base cards checked for segmentation, dictionary lemma, kana, ASCII romaji, ruby bases, repetition and loanword source. No active frames edited, no human approval inferred.
Retained grouped 夕立=ゆうだち, 出来=でき, 馬鹿=ばか; ruby applies only to original kanji substrings. Katakana ココ and ダサい are native words stylized in katakana, so no foreign sourceWord is invented.
Only エリクサー is a katakana brand loanword here: sourceWord Elixir. 300mm is not an English lyric; its tentative spoken unit ミリ requires a short audio check because QQ preserves literal mm.

The proposal's changed grammarCards arrays are coordinated segmentation bundles, not permission to overwrite grammar/translation role changes. Follow the attached cardMapping, and regenerate final anchors/ruby/layout after integration.
No need to mechanically change correct base readings/romaji merely to relabel status. All status fields remain draft/unapproved.
